title: account_record v1
description: One local account with UID at or above the agent's uid_min, as read from the account database in one pass. Emitted once per account, before the account_inventory_snapshot of the same run_id.

shell.description: Login shell as written in the source. Empty string when the field is empty.

login_enabled.description: False when the shell ends in /nologin or /false. An empty shell means /bin/sh, so it is true.
